articles.title_cn: “水母UFO”目击视频席卷网络，我们展开了调查
articles.summary_cn: 11月上中旬，网络上流传大量视频，似乎显示水母状或章鱼状物体高悬空中。网友将这一所谓现象称为“水母UFO”。
articles.body_cn:
11月上中旬，网络上流传着大量视频，画面似乎显示水母状或章鱼状的物体高悬于天空。网友将这一所谓现象称为“水母UFO”，相关视频迅速在社交平台扩散，引发广泛讨论。

这些影像的来源、拍摄地点与真实性各不相同，部分片段因画质模糊、缺乏参照物而难以核实。围绕这些视频，网络上出现了大量猜测与解读，但截至目前，尚无权威机构对其性质作出确认。

articles.title: Navy Releases Massive Cache of Scott Bray UAP Emails After Four Years; More Than 300 Pages Withheld in Full
articles.summary: The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort. The records were obtained by The Black Vault [...] The post Navy Releases Massive
articles.body:
The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort.
The records were obtained by The Black Vault through a Freedom of Information Act request filed on May 24, 2022. The request sought emails sent to, from, copied to or blind-copied to Bray containing terms including “Unidentified Aerial Phenomena,” “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “AATIP,” “AAWSAP” and several related phrases.
More than four years later, the Navy responded on September 23, 2026. According to its response, the search located 1,321 pages of responsive records. The Navy withheld 302 pages in their entirety, while releasing the remaining 1,019 pages with redactions under several FOIA exemptions.
Bray served as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence and Director of the Naval Intelligence Activity during much of the period covered by the records. His position placed him within a network of Navy, Defense Department and Intelligence Community officials dealing with UAP reporting, briefings, congressional interest and the development of what ultimately became the Navy-led Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force.
One email in the release described the relationship directly, stating that John “Jay” Stratton “leads the UAP Task Force effort for Navy… working directly for Scott Bray, our Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.”
Bray later became one of the government’s most visible officials on the UAP issue. On May 17, 2022, he appeared with Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Ronald Moultrie before a House Intelligence subcommittee during a public congressional hearing devoted to UAP. The hearing was followed by a classified session.
The newly released records provide a much larger documentary backdrop to that public role.
A Broad Look Behind the Government’s UAP Effort
The correspondence stretches across years and includes exchanges involving Stratton, Defense Intelligence official Neill Tipton, senior Navy officials, admirals, Pentagon public-affairs personnel and other Defense and Intelligence Community officials.
For example, a March 2020 exchange shows Tipton, who was then identified in his signature block as Director of Defense Intelligence, Collection and Special Programs in OUSD(I&S), telling Bray that he had a document “relevant to our discussion the other day” that he preferred to deliver in hard copy. Other correspondence concerning a planned Senate Select Committee on Intelligence briefing includes Bray, Stratton, Tipton and Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Elsewhere, the records show Stratton discussing proposed public language concerning the UAP effort and whether it should be reviewed by Bray before being sent forward. Other email traffic includes Vice Adm. Matthew Kohler, Rear Adm. Charles Brown and Rear Adm.
articles.title_cn: 海军时隔四年公开斯科特·布雷大量UAP邮件，逾300页被全文扣留
articles.summary_cn: 美国海军部公开了1300多页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷的邮件及相关记录，为外界了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期的政府通信打开了一扇窗口。这些记录由The Black Vault获取。
articles.body_cn:
美国海军部公开了1300多页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为外界了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期的政府通信打开了一扇窗口。

这些记录由The Black Vault依据2022年5月24日提交的《信息自由法》（FOIA）申请获取。该申请要求提供发送给布雷、由布雷发出、抄送或密送给他、且包含“Unidentified Aerial Phenomena”“UAP”“UAPTF”“UFO”“AATIP”“AAWSAP”等若干相关词条的邮件。

四年多后，海军于2026年9月23日作出回应。根据其答复，检索共找到1321页相关记录。海军将其中302页全文扣留，其余1019页则在若干FOIA豁免条款下经涂黑处理后公开。

在记录所涵盖的大部分时期内，布雷担任海军情报局副局长兼海军情报活动主任。他的职位使他处于一个由海军、国防部和情报界官员组成的网络之中，负责处理UAP报告、简报、国会关注以及最终发展为海军主导的不明空中现象特别工作组的相关工作。

公开的一封邮件直接描述了这一关系，称约翰·“杰伊”·斯特拉顿（John “Jay” Stratton）“领导海军的UAP特别工作组工作……直接向我们的海军情报局副局长斯科特·布雷汇报”。

布雷后来成为政府在UAP问题上最受关注的官员之一。2022年5月17日，他与国防部负责情报与安全事务的副部长罗纳德·莫尔特里（Ronald Moultrie）一同出席众议院情报小组委员会的公开国会听证会，该听证会专门讨论UAP问题。听证会后还举行了保密会议。

新公开的记录为这一公开角色提供了规模大得多的文献背景。

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到美国中央情报局的《信息自由法》电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn:
美国中央情报局（CIA）的《信息自由法》（FOIA）电子阅览室，是该机构面向公众开放解密档案与信息公开材料的在线平台。用户可通过该阅览室查阅依据《信息自由法》处理并公布的各类文件，其中也包括与UFO、UAP相关的历史档案。

电子阅览室按主题和文件类型对公开记录进行分类整理，方便研究者与公众检索。对于关注不明空中现象议题的人士而言，这一平台是获取政府历史文件的重要渠道之一。

articles.title: Giant ‘Pterodactyl’ Described In 2010 Pentagon UFO Files Sparks Bizarre Theory About Interdimensional Creatures
articles.summary: Pterodactyl in night sky Just when we thought the recent reports of a prehistoric flying creature being spotted near the U.S.-Mexico border couldn't get ...
articles.body:
Just when we thought the recent reports of a prehistoric flying creature being spotted near the U.S.-Mexico border couldn’t get any stranger, newly released Pentagon UFO files have added another wrinkle to the mystery.
Apparently, people inUtahreported something similar to a pterodactyl almost 20 years ago. And now there are even theories that these creatures might be traveling between dimensions.
Pentagon UFO Files Detail Encounter With Giant ‘Pterodactyl’
According to theDaily Mail,a report included inrecently released Pentagon UFO documentsdescribes an encounter with a massive, prehistoric-looking bird near Skinwalker Ranch in Utah.
The witnesses told investigators in 2010 that they encountered the pterodactyl-like creature sometime around 2006 or 2007 after returning home from playing basketball.
They described it as black, approximately four feet tall, with a 12-foot wingspan and a head and beak measuring two to three feet long. They also said they heard its wings flapping and watched branches move as it descended into nearby trees.
The witnesses were apparently so frightened by the creature’s size that they ran inside, fearing it could pick them up and carry them away. (Maybe it wasa prehistoric eagle?)
Investigators never identified whatever they saw.
Could These Supposed Pterodactyls Be Traveling Between Dimensions?
The description from the Pentagon files closely matchesrecent videos allegedly showing pterodactylsflying over Ciudad Juárez, Mexico.
One recording, reportedly filmed November 7, supposedly shows a pterodactyl taking flight after attacking a dog and attempting to carry it away. That account has not been independently verified.
Controversial UFO researcherJaime Maussan, who has promoted the footage, now believes the creature might actually be a Pteranodon. He also floated another possibility.
“Is the creature recently filmed in the Juárez Valley evidence that a dimensional portal is located there?” he askedon X.
As ridiculous as that might sound, Maussan isn’t the first person to suggest creatures could be traveling between universes.
Aswe previously reported, Scottish paranormal investigator Ron Halliday once proposed a similar explanation for theLoch Ness Monster.
“Scientists have suggested there could be other universes. And somehow our world interacts with these other worlds through portals,” Halliday explained. “With the Loch Ness monster, people could be seeing a dinosaur that existed in the past. They may see something that looks solid, but isn’t actually in our world.”
Halliday also suggested the theory could explainUFOsightings.
Are The Pterodactyl Sightings Real Or Just Another Hoax?
Of course, there’s no scientific evidence that prehistoric creatures are using interdimensional portals.
There’s the small matter of pterosaurs having gone extinct around 66 million years ago. Expertshave also suggestedthe Mexico videos could be AI-generated or CGI.

articles.title_cn: 2010年五角大楼UFO文件记载巨型“翼龙”，引发跨维度生物离奇理论
articles.summary_cn: 就在我们以为近期美墨边境附近发现史前飞行生物的报道已经够离奇时，新公开的五角大楼UFO文件又为这一谜团增添了新的疑点。
articles.body_cn:
就在我们以为近期美墨边境附近发现史前飞行生物的报道已经够离奇时，新公开的五角大楼UFO文件又为这一谜团增添了新的疑点。

据报道，近期公开的五角大楼UFO文件中包含一份报告，描述了在犹他州Skinwalker Ranch附近遭遇一只巨大的、形似史前生物的鸟类的经历。

目击者于2010年告诉调查人员，他们大约在2006年或2007年打完篮球回家后遭遇了这只类似翼龙的生物。他们描述其通体黑色，高约四英尺，翼展达12英尺，头部和喙长约两到三英尺。他们还称听到了翅膀拍动的声音，并看到树枝晃动，该生物随后降入附近的树林。

目击者显然被这只生物的体型吓坏了，跑进屋内，担心它会把它们抓走。调查人员始终未能确认他们看到的究竟是什么。

五角大楼文件中的描述，与近期据称显示翼龙飞越墨西哥华雷斯城（Ciudad Juárez）上空的视频高度吻合。其中一段据称拍摄于11月7日的录像，据称显示一只翼龙在袭击一只狗并试图将其带走后起飞。该说法尚未得到独立核实。

曾推广该画面的争议性UFO研究者海梅·毛桑（Jaime Maussan）现在认为，这只生物实际上可能是一只无齿翼龙。他还提出了另一种可能性。他在X平台上问道：“最近在华雷斯谷拍摄到的这只生物，是否是那里存在维度门户的证据？”

articles.title: Pentagon Releases New UFO Video, Secret Skinwalker Ranch Files And Bizarre Eyewitness Sketches
articles.summary: UFO passing over a US warship The Pentagon has released another batch of UFO files, including footage of a mysterious object flying past a Navy warship, ...
articles.body:
The Pentagon has released another batch of UFO files, including footage of a mysterious object flying past a Navy warship, reports of bizarre activity at Skinwalker Ranch, and strange eyewitness sketches dating back over 70 years.
The eighth batch of governmentUFOrecords, which brings the total number of released files to more than 500 since May, contains about 40 documents and three videos.
The documentsalso show how seriously the government took UFO sightings decades ago, even as they publicly dismissed many of them.
New Pentagon UFO Video Shows Mysterious Object Near Warship
One of the newly released videos shows a small, bright object (pictured above) moving across the bow of aU.S. Navywarship in the Middle East in 2020. The footage was captured on an infrared camera, and the object remains unidentified.
Another file details a 1953 UFO sighting by Clarence “Kelly” Johnson, a Lockheed engineer who helped develop the U-2 and SR-71 spy planes.
Johnson told investigators he watched for at least three minutes as a black, elliptical object hovered near his California ranch before it shot away at high speed. Another Lockheed flight crew allegedly spotted the object, as well.
“I am now more firmly convinced than ever that such devices exist, and I have some highly technical converts in this belief as of that date,” Johnson wrote.
Despite Johnson’s credentials, the Air Force dismissed the sighting as a lenticular cloud.
The files also contain a 1957 report by five men fishing near Martha’s Vineyard who said they saw a cylindrical object covered with spikes. Two of the men wereAir ForceReserve pilots.
Another report from Michigan that year said a 15-year-old boy drew a picture of what he said was a 120-foot-wideflying saucernear the Enrico Fermi atomic plant, which he and a friend had seen.
CIA Briefing Shows Massive Interest In UFOs In The 1950s
Perhaps even more interesting is a1952 CIA briefingwarning that public knowledge of the agency’s interest in UFOs could make matters worse. TheCIAalso conceded that it had been deluged with requests for UFO information, including one from the White House.
“Outside knowledge of Agency interest in Flying Saucers carries the risk of making the problem even more serious in the public mind than it already is,” the briefing stated.
Pentagon Files Reveal Bizarre Skinwalker Ranch Investigation
Some of the oddest documents are tied toSkinwalker Ranch, the Utah property where decades of reported UFO sightings, cattle mutilations and paranormal activity have taken place. This release marks the government’s first official acknowledgment of a 538-page report prepared in 2009 by Pentagon contractor Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS).

articles.title_cn: 五角大楼公开新UFO视频、Skinwalker Ranch机密文件及离奇目击者素描
articles.summary_cn: 五角大楼又公开了一批UFO文件，包括一段神秘物体飞过海军军舰的画面、Skinwalker Ranch的离奇活动报告，以及可追溯至70多年前的怪异目击者素描。
articles.body_cn:
五角大楼又公开了一批UFO文件，包括一段神秘物体飞过海军军舰的画面、Skinwalker Ranch的离奇活动报告，以及可追溯至70多年前的怪异目击者素描。

这是政府UFO记录的第8批公开文件，使自5月以来公布的文件总数超过500份。本批包含约40份文件和3段视频。这些文件还显示，尽管政府公开淡化许多UFO目击事件，但数十年前他们对待此类事件的态度其实相当认真。

新公布的一段视频显示，2020年在中东，一个小而明亮的物体（如上图所示）从一艘美国海军军舰的舰艏前方掠过。该画面由红外摄像机拍摄，物体身份仍未确定。

另一份文件详细记载了1953年洛克希德工程师克拉伦斯·“凯利”·约翰逊（Clarence “Kelly” Johnson）的一次UFO目击事件。约翰逊曾参与研制U-2和SR-71侦察机。他告诉调查人员，他至少观察了三分钟，一个黑色椭圆形物体在他位于加利福尼亚的农场附近悬停，随后高速飞离。据称另一组洛克希德飞行机组也看到了该物体。约翰逊写道：“我现在比以往任何时候都更坚信此类装置确实存在，而且自那以后，我已有一些技术背景很强的人转而相信这一点。”尽管约翰逊资历深厚，空军仍将此次目击解释为荚状云。

文件还包含一份1957年的报告，五名男子在马撒葡萄园岛（Martha's Vineyard）附近钓鱼时称看到一个布满尖刺的圆柱形物体。其中两人是空军预备役飞行员。同年密歇根州的另一份报告称，一名15岁男孩画下了他所说的一个宽120英尺的飞碟，他和一位朋友在恩里科·费米（Enrico Fermi）核电站附近看到了它。

或许更有趣的是一份1952年的CIA简报，其中警告称，公众若得知该机构对UFO的兴趣，可能会使……

articles.title: Former Pentagon UFO chief disputes FBI black triangle sighting, says reports lack evidence
articles.summary: The former Pentagon UFO office chief says the FBI's triangular object sighting lacks evidence, calling witness credibility a "classic authority bias." ...
articles.body:
The former head of thePentagon's UFO investigation officeis pouring cold water on a mysterious black triangular object reportedly spotted by FBI personnel, telling Fox News Digital that the newly released account lacks the evidence needed to determine what the witnesses actually saw.
Sean Kirkpatrick, the former director of the Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO), said strange sightings detailed in recently declassified government records should be viewed through an evidence-based lens rather than as proof of something extraterrestrial.
The records include a 2026 sighting involving FBI personnel who reported seeing a dark, nonreflective triangular object with no visible engines, exhaust or conventional propulsion system rise above a mountain ridge before rapidly disappearing into a canyon.
NEW TRUMP UFO FILE DUMP INCLUDES MILITARY FOOTAGE OF MYSTERIOUS STAR-SHAPED OBJECT
A separate AARO report described amatte-black triangular objectthat climbed about 200 to 300 feet above the ridgeline, hovered for roughly 20 seconds and then appeared to accelerate almost instantly.
Kirkpatrick, who spent nearly 30 years in the Department of Defense and intelligence community, said the witnesses' FBI backgrounds alone are not enough to validate what they reported seeing.
NASA CHIEF PULLS BACK CURTAIN ON TRUMP UFO FILES AFTER BIZARRE FINDS SURFACE IN BURIED FED RECORDS
"There's a lot of people that like to point to folks as being credible witnesses and therefore their testimony must be taken at face value," Kirkpatrick told Fox News Digital. "And that is a classic case of authority bias."
Kirkpatrick said the lack of photographs or other supporting evidence makes it difficult to determine what, if anything, the witnesses encountered.
NEIL DEGRASSE TYSON DARES GOVERNMENT TO 'JUST SHOW THE ALIEN,' AS DISCLOSURE FERVOR CONTINUES TO GROW
"Some of this is just, ‘hey, I saw something, I don't know what it is,’" Kirkpatrick said. "People sometimes have a tendency to fill that gap with very extreme beliefs that have time and again proven to be inaccurate and fallible."
He pointed toadvanced aerospace technologyas one possible explanation for some triangular sightings, comparing them to reports involving the F-117 stealth aircraft before the technology became widely known.
PENTAGON FILES REVEAL AGENTS' REPORTS OF 'ORBS LAUNCHING ORBS' NEAR SENSITIVE US SECURITY SITE
AARO approached UAP reports by examining three broad possibilities, Kirkpatrick said: advanced technology used by a foreign adversary, ordinary objects or sensor effects that are misunderstood, or an extraterrestrial explanation.
"You've got 3 very distinct buckets," Kirkpatrick said.

Each possibility has specific signatures that investigators can compare against data collected from a sighting, he explained.

articles.title_cn: 五角大楼前UFO主管质疑FBI黑色三角物体目击事件，称报告缺乏证据
articles.summary_cn: 五角大楼UFO办公室前负责人表示，FBI人员目击三角形物体的说法缺乏证据，并将目击者的可信度称为“典型的权威偏误”。
articles.body_cn:
五角大楼UFO调查办公室前负责人对据称由FBI人员目击的神秘黑色三角形物体泼了冷水，他告诉福克斯新闻数字版，新公开的说法缺乏确定目击者究竟看到了什么所需的证据。

五角大楼全域异常解析办公室（AARO）前主任肖恩·柯克帕特里克（Sean Kirkpatrick）表示，近期解密政府记录中详述的离奇目击事件，应以基于证据的视角来看待，而非将其视为外星事物的证据。

这些记录包括一起2026年的目击事件，涉及FBI人员报告称看到一个深色、不反光的三角形物体，没有可见的发动机、尾焰或常规推进系统，它升上山脊后迅速消失在一处峡谷中。

另一份AARO报告描述了一个哑光黑色的三角形物体，它爬升至山脊线上方约200至300英尺，悬停约20秒，随后似乎几乎瞬间加速。

在国防部和情报界工作近30年的柯克帕特里克表示，仅凭目击者的FBI背景，不足以证实他们所报告的内容。

柯克帕特里克告诉福克斯新闻数字版：“有很多人喜欢指出某些人是可信的目击者，因此他们的证词必须被照单全收。这是典型的权威偏误。”

柯克帕特里克表示，缺乏照片或其他佐证，使得难以确定目击者究竟遭遇了什么——如果真有其事的话。

柯克帕特里克说：“其中一些只是‘嘿，我看到了什么东西，我不知道那是什么’。人们有时会有一种倾向，去填补……”
